sloka: इदं तावत्सुवर्णं च धनं वस्त्राणि च द्विज ।भक्ष्यं भोज्यं च ब्रह्मर्षे ददात्याभरणानि च ।। ७.७८.२५ ॥
transliteration: idaṁ tāvatsuvarṇaṁ ca dhanaṁ vastrāṇi ca dvija ।bhakṣyaṁ bhojyaṁ ca brahmarṣe dadātyābharaṇāni ca ।। 7.78.25 ॥

translations.english: O brahmin, O Brahmarshi, this indeed gives gold, wealth, clothes, food to be chewed, food to be eaten, and ornaments.
